title.value: Beyond Disjointed Text Boxes: Orchestrating Every Piece of Content and Its Metadata with CKEditor AI

summary.value: Webinar where I interviewed Witek Socha (Senior Technical Product Manager, CKEditor) on how CKEditor AI works across multi-root and multi-editor setups - keeping AI assistance accurate, contextual, and predictable no matter how the editing UI is composed.

value.description: Beyond Disjointed Text Boxes: Orchestrating Every Piece of Content and Its Metadata with CKEditor AI

content.value:
What the session covered

Software applications rarely have one editor on a page. Email composers have subject, body, and signature fields. CMS workflows split content into title, abstract, and body. Forms, page builders, and internal portals stitch together dozens of structured, editable regions. Bringing AI into those interfaces - without confusing users or losing context between fields - is where most integrations break down.

What you'll learn from the recording

  • How CKEditor AI operates across multiple editable regions within a single editor instance, preserving per-root context and formatting.
  • How to coordinate AI features across multiple independent editor instances with different configurations on the same page - without state collisions.
  • How to direct AI Chat, Quick Actions, Review, and Translate to the right piece of content, with the right context, every time.

Who it was for

CTOs, software architects, product managers, and engineering teams building structured, multi-field editing experiences where AI needs to behave correctly across every input.
